verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs mention 'ramp schedules' and scheduling for feature-flag rule rollout (e.g., starting/stopping a rollout at a set time), but this is a one-off flag-activation timing feature, not a general recurring-job/workflow scheduler that an AI-native user could use to automate recurring tasks. No evidence of cron-like recurring automation, workflow orchestration, or scheduled pipeline execution.
